title: No Archetype Serves a qa-Type Task

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a task whose type is qa, When an archetype is proposed for it by nit:tasks or nit:analyze, Then the proposed archetype's implement step dispatches to the qa engineer.
Given every task type the schema allows, When each is checked against the shipped archetypes, Then at least one archetype's implement step reaches that type's engineer, asserted by test.
Given registry/task-types.json, When a qa task looks up its defaultArchetype, Then that archetype exists and satisfies AC-1.
